newsitem.title: USA: Alamco proven reserves up eight percent.
newsitem.headline: Alamco proven reserves up eight percent.

text.p: Alamco Inc said Thursday its proved oil and natural gas reserves increased to 147.8 equivalent billion cubic feet at the end of 1996.
That represents an increase of 10.7 billion cubic feet over year-end 1995 reserves of 137.1 billion, the company said.
The company said it replaced over 250 percent of its production last year, and that its proved reserves were 92 percent natural gas and eight percent oil at the end of 1996.
Proved developed reserves increased to 84 percent of total proved reserves, up from 77 percent at year-end 1995.
The present value before tax of year-end 1996 proved reserves, discounted at 10 percent, was $150.6 million.
